  APPLICATION OF SOUTHWESTERN ELECTRIC POWER

RETAIL ELECTRIC SERVICE TO INCLUDE NEW STANDARD
FORM CONTRACT FOR ELECTRIC SERVICE – LARGE LOAD




                             SOAH ORDER NO. 11
                       GRANTING MOTION TO ABATE


      On September 2, 2026, Southwestern Electric Power Company filed an
agreed motion to abate this proceeding, stating that the parties have reached a
settlement in principle. The motion is GRANTED, and the procedural schedule is
ABATED. The parties SHALL file, no later than September 9, 2026, either a
status report or settlement materials.
 Signed September 2, 2026


                                       ALJ Signature(s):


                                       _____________________________
                                       Daniel Wiseman,
                                       Presiding Administrative Law Judge
